tracking: ADR-0357 (lane E38): the brief is API and backend only (master brief 2026-11-17, rule 3); the governance-config export and plan-review screen is requested on #453

gaps.GET /v1/governance-config/schema: serves the JSON Schema of the governance-config document (for editors and CI)
gaps.GET /v1/governance-config/export: exports the org's roles, rate limits, MCP bundles, workflow templates and budgets as a versioned YAML or JSON document, never a secret (audited)
gaps.POST /v1/governance-config/plan: dry-runs a governance-config document: validates, resolves names, diffs against live and marks each change widens/narrows/neutral (audited, writes nothing)
